environmentVariables.name: ZAAI_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Per-user MCP token, prefix zaai_mcp_. Mint at https://zaaidev.com/dev/settings/tokens (kind = mcp). Sent as Bearer auth on every workspace request; scopes the server to one user's captures and optionally a project allowlist.

environmentVariables.name: ZAAI_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Workspace base URL. Defaults to https://zaaidev.com. Override only for local dev or staging.
